Schema (the tables most likely to be needed):
code_lookup - Meaning of every coded column in the other tables: code_type (which code list: ORD_STATUS, TIER, REFUND_STATUS, REFUND_REASON, TKT_CATEG, REGION, CHANNEL, DEPT); code_val (the stored code); code_desc (what the code means in words)
cust_master - Customer master record: cust_id (customer id, like C-1002); cust_nm (customer name); tier_cd (loyalty tier: P platinum, G gold, S standard); region_cd (sales region: NA, EU, AP, LA); signup_dt (date the customer signed up); is_actv (1 = active, 0 = closed or inactive (soft delete)); email_addr (contact email address); phone_no (contact phone number)
ord_hdr - Order header, one row per order: ord_id (order id, like O-5002); cust_id (customer who placed the order); ord_dt (order date); ord_status (N new, S shipped, D delivered, C cancelled, R returned); ord_total_amt (order total in the ORDER currency (currency_cd), already net of line discounts); currency_cd (currency of ord_total_amt); channel_cd (sales channel: WEB, APP, PHN, STR)  FK: cust_id->cust_master.cust_id
support_tkt - Support tickets: tkt_id (ticket id, like T-70010); cust_id (customer who raised the ticket); opened_ts (when the ticket was opened); closed_ts (when it was closed; NULL means the ticket is still open); sev_lvl (severity: 1 critical, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low); categ_cd (category: BILL billing, SHIP shipping, TECH technical, ACCT account, REFD refunds); assigned_emp_id (employee working it; NULL if not yet assigned); channel_cd (how it arrived: WEB, APP, PHN, STR)  FK: cust_id->cust_master.cust_id
tkt_event - Ticket history: evt_id (event id); tkt_id (ticket the event belongs to); evt_ts (when it happened); evt_type (OPEN, ASSIGN, REPLY, ESCAL (escalated), CLOSE); actor_emp_id (employee who did it; NULL for customer actions)  FK: tkt_id->support_tkt.tkt_id
policy_rule - Policy values that change over time; pick the row in force on the date you care about: rule_id (rule row id); rule_key (which policy: refund_approval_threshold (USD amount above which a refund needs manager approval), sla_hours_sev1 (hours to resolve a critical ticket)); rule_val (the value, stored as text); eff_from (first date the value applies); eff_to (last date the value applies; NULL = still in force)
shipment - Shipments, one per shipped order: ship_id (shipment id, like S-8001); ord_id (order shipped); wh_id (warehouse it left from); carrier_cd (carrier: UPS, DHL, FDX, USP); ship_dt (date handed to the carrier); deliv_dt (date delivered; NULL until delivered); ship_status (shipment state: I in transit, D delivered)  FK: ord_id->ord_hdr.ord_id
How many shipping tickets?

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'SHIP'
```

